name: digestif-node
description: The node's local API: what the web UI on localhost reads and writes. The node serves the static UI and this API from one origin bound to 127.0.0.1. It opens the UI through a one-time launch URL that sets an HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict session cookie, and refuses any request without that cookie and a Digestif-Local: 1 header. The custom header forces a CORS preflight, which the node never answers, so a page on another origin can neither read nor post. Later the relay serves the same UI as the phone web app against the same operations. Nothing here is wire format: the relay contract is spec/digestif-relay.json and docs/protocol.md.

operations.description: Run the agent check on the program and answer with its verdict; the program is saved as the agent only when the check passes. 200.description: The check's verdict: passed (the program is saved) or failed (it is not).

422.description: Not a program (code not_a_program, field path), or a check is still running (code checking).

404.description: No check since the node started.
